curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
d=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('runs',d)
for r in d:
    tr=r.get('trades',[])
    op=[x for x in tr if x.get('open')]
    cl=[x for x in tr if not x.get('open')]
    print(r['id'],r['name'],r['cfg'].get('tf'),r['cfg']['stages'][0]['t'],'closed',len(cl),'open',len(op),'net',round(sum(x.get('net',0) for x in cl),2), 'tp_in_trades',sum(1 for x in tr if x.get('tp')))
" ; ls /opt/trading-bot/classic | head -50; systemctl is-active classicbot classic-dashboard; ss -ltn | grep -E '8091|18092|8093|8092'
